headline: Last session: Sensex plunges 989 points as bears take charge, dragged by IT and HDFC Bank

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 30 November.

why: Bears took control as the Sensex plunged 989 points and Nifty slipped below 25,650 on November 27.
Heavy dragging from IT stocks and HDFC Bank weighed heavily on the indices.
Profit taking emerged after a multi-day rally earlier in the week.
Market momentum turned negative following strong gains on November 25 and 26.
whatHappening: In the last session on November 27, Sensex sank 989 points while Nifty settled around 25,600.
HDFC Bank and IT stocks led the downturn after acting as major gainers in previous trading sessions.
The market had previously surged 1,502 points on November 25 and gained 390 points on November 26.
Trading is closed today, November 28, due to the weekend and will resume on Monday, November 30.
summary:
On the last trading day, Indian equity benchmarks fell sharply with the Sensex tumbling 989 points and Nifty closing near 25,600.
The market fall was driven by selling pressure in IT shares and HDFC Bank, reversing gains from earlier in the week.
The market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 30 November.
